Meta jumps 3% as its brand‑new Muse AI models directly challenge OpenAI and Anthropic. Meta Platforms (META-US) unveiled two new AI models, Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, on Monday (the 12th). The rollout reflects the company’s increasingly unified AI strategy and the models’ public‑test performance that rivals top offerings from OpenAI and Anthropic.

Intel pushes a new GPU chip to take on Nvidia, driving its AI transformation. Intel’s (INTC-US) AI‑focused pivot is being boosted by the global expansion of AI infrastructure, lifting CPU demand. The company is also expanding into GPUs with the Intel GPU D‑Series processor, formerly codenamed Crescent Island, designed for AI inference and model serving.

Microsoft doesn’t want to rely solely on Nvidia. On Monday (the 12th) Microsoft (MSFT-US) announced its third‑generation in‑house AI chip, Maia 300, with plans to deploy potentially over one million units next year to power internal AI services and cut compute costs by improving system efficiency. The large‑scale rollout underscores the industry’s push to reduce dependence on Nvidia (NVDA-US).

Chips are available, but money is getting harder to find. Broadcom (AVGO-US) CEO Chen Fuyang said on Monday (the 12th) that financing has become the biggest constraint on AI growth, as the cost of building and scaling AI systems rises each year, making capital harder to secure than the chips themselves.

items.title: AI改寫半導體人力模式！應材預告營收翻倍、人不加倍 砸50億美元啟用EPIC新廠
items.title_en: AI Rewrites Semiconductor Workforce Model! Applied Materials Forecasts Revenue Doubling, Not Workforce, and Invests $5 Billion in New EPIC Facility
paras: 美國最大半導體設備製造商應用材料(Applied Materials)(AMAT-US)預期，未來幾年營收將增為目前的兩倍，但員工人數不會同步增加，因為該公司正更廣泛運用人工智慧(AI)工具，協助產品開發、品質管制與提升生產效率。
應材執行長Gary Dickerson在公司新設施EPIC Center開幕前受訪時說：「未來幾年，當公司的規模擴大至兩倍時，員工人數不會跟著增加至兩倍。」
EPIC Center斥資50億美元興建，旨在讓晶片製造商與研究人員及設備合作夥伴攜手，加快半導體製程與設備的研發及商業化。
應材正受惠於AI熱潮帶動的半導體設備需求，也把AI運用於自己的創新、產品開發，以及提高半導體良率上。
Dickerson說：「對客戶而言，能生產出更多良品，就代表可創造可觀的價值。」應材正與客戶合作，在實際生產環境中運用AI，提高「每片晶圓的良品晶片數量，以及每天處理的晶圓數量」。
Dickerson未透露對未來幾年員工人數的預測，應材截至7月底約有3萬8,900名員工。
他表示，應材仍會在部分領域招募人手，即使這些領域已因AI而大幅提升生產力，在部分情況下，生產力增幅約達50%。
EPIC Center位於加州桑尼維爾，占地60萬平方英尺，設有近1.6公頃的先進無塵室空間，可供合作夥伴進行晶片研發。該中心與台積電(TSM-US)(2330-TW)、英特爾(INTC-US)、三星電子(Samsung Electronics)、美光科技(MU-SU)及SK海力士(SKHY-US)等客戶合作興建。
Dickerson也提醒，AI基礎建設短期內可能面臨融資、供應、能源及產能不足等問題，拖慢擴張速度，但他認為，長期成長將帶來「轉型性」影響。
他說：「短期內，確實有一些因素可能拖慢成長速度。但無論哪種情境，成長都將相當顯著。」
(本文不開放合作夥伴轉載)
paras_en: Applied Materials (AMAT-US), the largest U.S. semiconductor equipment maker, expects its revenue to double over the next few years, but its headcount will not rise in step because the company is increasingly using artificial intelligence (AI) tools to aid product development, quality control and boost production efficiency.

CEO Gary Dickerson said in an interview before the opening of the company’s new EPIC Center that “when the company’s scale expands to twice its size over the coming years, the employee count will not double accordingly.”

The EPIC Center, built at a cost of $5 billion, is intended to let chip makers, researchers and equipment partners work together to accelerate semiconductor process and equipment R&D and commercialization.
Applied Materials is benefiting from the AI‑driven surge in demand for semiconductor equipment and is also applying AI to its own innovation, product development, and to improve semiconductor yield.

Dickerson said, “For customers, being able to produce more good chips translates into substantial value.” The company is working with customers to use AI in real‑world production to increase the number of good dies per wafer and the number of wafers processed each day.
Dickerson did not disclose a forecast for employee numbers in the coming years; Applied Materials had about 38,900 employees as of the end of July.
He noted that the firm will still hire in certain areas even though AI has dramatically lifted productivity in those fields, in some cases by roughly 50 %.

The EPIC Center is located in Sunnyvale, California, covering 600,000 square feet and featuring nearly 1.6 hectares of advanced clean‑room space for partners to conduct chip research. The center is being built in collaboration with customers such as TSMC (TSM-US, 2330‑TW), Intel (INTC‑US), Samsung Electronics, Micron Technology (MU‑SU) and SK Hynix (SKHY‑US).

Dickerson also warned that AI infrastructure could face short‑term challenges such as financing, supply, energy and capacity constraints that may slow expansion, but he believes the long‑term growth will have a “transformational” impact.
He said, “In the short term, there are indeed some factors that could slow growth. However, regardless of the scenario, growth will be quite significant.”
(This article is not open for partner re‑publication)

items.title: 歐盟通過單次最大規模制裁名單 一半涉俄羅斯彈道飛彈
items.title_en: EU Approves Largest One‑Time Sanctions List, Over Half Target Russia's Ballistic Missile Program
paras: 歐盟成員國外長12日（周一）在盧森堡舉行的會議上通過對俄羅斯單次最大規模制裁名單，新增近1,600名個人和實體，主要涉及俄羅斯軍工領域。
歐盟理事會當天發表聲明，稱此次新增制裁對象包括826家俄羅斯企業和擔任這些企業執行長的743名個人，制裁專門針對俄羅斯軍工產業的中游供應商。
歐盟理事會說，這些企業為俄羅斯飛彈、無人機、飛機等武器系統提供關鍵零件，涉及半導體、微電路、通訊設備、雷達、航空航天、彈藥、光學、導航系統等領域。
根據歐盟現行規定，被制裁的個人和實體在歐盟境內資產將被凍結，歐盟禁止直接或間接向其提供資金或經濟資源。被列名個人也會面臨歐盟旅行禁令。
歐盟外交與安全政策高級代表卡拉斯表示，此次制裁名單中超過一半的對象涉及俄羅斯彈道飛彈生產鏈，當前應進一步加大對俄施壓。
歐盟領導人將於15日至16日在布魯塞爾舉行峰會，討論繼續支援烏克蘭等問題。
paras_en: EU foreign ministers on Monday, the 12th, approved a one‑time maximum‑scale sanctions list against Russia at a meeting in Luxembourg, adding nearly 1,600 individuals and entities, mainly from Russia’s defence sector.

The EU Council issued a statement the same day saying the new sanctions cover 826 Russian companies and 743 individuals who serve as CEOs of those firms, targeting mid‑stream suppliers to Russia’s defence industry.

The Council said these firms provide critical components for Russian missiles, drones, aircraft and other weapon systems, spanning semiconductors, microcircuits, communications equipment, radar, aerospace, munitions, optics and navigation systems.

Under current EU rules, assets of sanctioned persons and entities within the EU will be frozen and the EU will prohibit direct or indirect funding or economic resources to them. Listed individuals will also face an EU travel ban.

EU High Representative for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy Josep Borrell said that more than half of the names on the list are linked to Russia’s ballistic‑missile production chain and that pressure on Moscow must be stepped up further.
EU leaders will meet in Brussels on 15‑16 October for a summit to discuss, among other issues, continued support for Ukraine.

items.title: DeepSeek領投機器人AI新創Winverse AI 種子輪融資後估值達4億美元
items.title_en: DeepSeek Leads Seed Round for Robot AI Startup Winverse AI, Valuing It at $400 Million Post‑Funding
paras: 中國人工智慧新創公司 DeepSeek 正將投資布局從大型語言模型擴展至機器人領域，據彭博報導，DeepSeek 已同意領投機器人 AI 新創公司 Winverse AI 的種子輪融資，該公司本輪融資後估值約達4億美元。本輪募資規模為數千萬美元，美團旗下投資機構 Long-Z Investments 也已承諾參與投資。不過，交易尚未正式完成，最終估值與投資人名單仍可能調整。
Winverse AI 於2026年在中國杭州成立，目前仍處於低調發展階段，專注開發讓機器人具備感知、理解指令及執行實際任務能力的人工智慧模型。公司創辦人胡瀚 (Hu Han) 曾任騰訊 (Tencent Holdings) (TCEHY-US) 視覺語言模型與具身基礎模型團隊的首席科學家，擁有清華大學博士學位，職涯也曾任職於微軟亞洲研究院及百度 (Baidu) (BIDU-US)。
胡瀚離開騰訊創業之際，正值騰訊調整 AI 研究組織、加速追趕中國人工智慧競爭對手之時。Winverse AI 的成立，反映中國 AI 研究人才正逐漸從大型科技企業轉向專注特定技術領域的新創實驗室，尤其是能讓人工智慧從數位環境走入實體世界的具身智慧 (embodied AI)。
此次投資也是 DeepSeek 成立以來較受矚目的新創投資案之一。DeepSeek 由梁文鋒於2023年創立，過去主要以大型語言模型及低成本 AI 技術聞名，如今則開始將資金投入能與其模型技術形成互補的企業，希望把 AI 能力延伸至人形機器人、工廠自動化及其他實際應用場景。
這項布局與 DeepSeek 自身的募資進展密切相關。根據彭博先前報導，DeepSeek 正接近完成至少800億元人民幣、約120億美元的新一輪募資，超越原先約500億元人民幣的募資目標。相關資金原本主要用於模型訓練與資料中心建設，但也可能支援新創投資及共同開發計畫，藉此建立更完整的 AI 產業生態系。
DeepSeek 此前已開始布局機器人產業。2026年8月，該公司以1.408億元人民幣、約2,080萬美元，取得人形機器人製造商宇樹科技 (Unitree Robotics) 上海上市案的2.31%策略性股權，並同意接受36個月的股份鎖定期，約為多數其他策略性投資人持有期限的3倍。相關安排被視為著重長期合作，而非單純追求短期投資報酬。
宇樹科技的合作方向，是讓 DeepSeek 的 AI 模型與機器人硬體相互配合。根據相關報導，雙方的合作安排包括，在 DeepSeek 採購模型訓練服務時優先考慮宇樹科技，而宇樹科技在為人形機器人尋找 AI 模型時，也優先考慮 DeepSeek 的技術。這使 DeepSeek 不僅透過財務投資參與機器人產業，也有機會建立模型開發與硬體應用之間的合作關係。
宇樹科技8月上市時，每股發行價格為150.80元人民幣，募集資金約61億元人民幣，估值約90億美元，成為中國首家在境內上市的人形機器人製造商之一。DeepSeek 對宇樹科技的投資，加上此次領投 Winverse AI，顯示其正從單純開發 AI 模型，進一步轉向投資能將模型應用於實體機器的企業。
人形機器人產業目前面臨的關鍵問題，不只是如何製造硬體，而是如何讓機器人理解人類語言、辨識陌生環境，並將抽象指令轉換成可靠的實際動作。大型語言模型擅長理解文字、生成內容與處理知識，但要讓機器人完成搬運、抓取、行走及工廠作業等任務，還需要整合視覺感知、空間理解、動作規劃及即時控制能力。
Winverse AI 瞄準的正是這項技術缺口。若能開發出可以理解自然語言指令、觀察周遭環境並執行複雜動作的模型，就有機會讓人形機器人從受限的示範環境，逐步進入工廠、倉庫及其他需要多步驟操作的工作場域。不過，這類模型仍須克服真實環境中的不確定性，包括物體位置變化、意外障礙、動作失誤及安全控制等問題。
中國已建立相當完整的機器人硬體製造與供應鏈體系，但讓機器人具備通用理解與行動能力的 AI 技術，仍是產業競爭的重要缺口。DeepSeek 選擇投資 Winverse AI，等於將資金投入能與既有模型能力互補的技術領域，希望透過專業團隊與硬體合作夥伴，縮短 AI 模型從數位應用走向實體作業的距離。

美國也有多家新創企業投入通用型機器人 AI。Skild AI 的估值據報約140億美元，Physical Intelligence 則約56億美元，兩家公司均獲得輝達 (NVIDIA) (NVDA-US) 與 Alphabet (Alphabet) (GOOGL-US) 等科技業者支持。相較之下，Winverse AI 目前仍處於種子輪融資階段，約4億美元的投資後估值明顯較低，但其發展方向與美國同業相似，都是希望打造能支援不同機器人硬體的通用 AI 大腦。
資金規模的差距也反映中美 AI 產業的融資環境不同。美國相關新創可獲得大型科技公司及創投市場支持，中國企業則受到資本來源、先進晶片取得及地緣政治等因素影響。DeepSeek 近期大規模募資，除了支援自身模型訓練與資料中心需求，也可能讓公司有更多資源投資專業 AI 團隊，藉由共同開發拓展技術應用。

對 DeepSeek 而言，投資 Winverse AI 不代表公司已具備成熟的機器人產品，也不代表相關技術已經完成商業驗證。這筆交易目前仍未定案，Winverse AI 的產品進度、技術表現與未來營收潛力，也尚待更多資訊確認。不過，從投資宇樹科技到領投 Winverse AI，DeepSeek 的布局已逐漸從語言模型擴展至具身智慧，反映 AI 產業的競爭焦點正從生成文字與回答問題，延伸至能在真實世界理解環境、規劃行動並完成工作的智慧系統。
paras_en: China AI startup DeepSeek is expanding its investment focus from large language models to the robotics sector. According to Bloomberg, DeepSeek has agreed to lead the seed round for robot AI startup Winverse AI, which is valued at roughly $400 million after this round. The raise is in the tens‑of‑millions of dollars, and Meituan‑affiliated investor Long‑Z Investments has also pledged to participate. The deal is not yet final, so the ultimate valuation and investor list could still change.

Winverse AI was founded in 2026 in Hangzhou, China, and remains in a low‑profile development stage, focusing on AI models that give robots perception, instruction understanding, and real‑world task execution capabilities. Founder Hu Han previously served as chief scientist for Tencent’s (TCEHY‑US) visual‑language and embodied foundation model teams, holds a PhD from Tsinghua University, and has worked at Microsoft Research Asia and Baidu (BIDU‑US).

Hu Han left Tencent to start his own venture at a time when Tencent was reshaping its AI research organization to catch up with Chinese AI rivals. Winverse AI’s creation reflects a trend of Chinese AI talent moving from big tech firms to niche‑focused startup labs, especially those aiming to bring AI out of digital environments into the physical world via embodied AI.

The investment is also one of DeepSeek’s most notable startup deals since its founding. DeepSeek, founded by Liang Wenfeng in 2023, has been known for large language models and low‑cost AI tech, and is now beginning to fund companies that complement its model technology, hoping to extend AI capabilities to humanoid robots, factory automation, and other practical applications.

This strategy is closely tied to DeepSeek’s own fundraising progress. Bloomberg previously reported that DeepSeek is close to completing a new round of at least 80 billion yuan (about $12 billion), exceeding its original target of roughly 50 billion yuan. The capital was originally earmarked for model training and data‑center construction, but may also support startup investments and joint‑development projects to build a more complete AI industry ecosystem.

DeepSeek has already begun moving into the robotics industry. In August 2026, the company invested 140.8 million yuan (about $20.8 million) for a 2.31% strategic stake in humanoid robot maker Unitree Robotics’ Shanghai listing, agreeing to a 36‑month lock‑up—about three times longer than most strategic investors—signaling a focus on long‑term partnership rather than short‑term returns.

Unitree Robotics’ collaboration aims to align DeepSeek’s AI models with robot hardware. Reports say the partnership includes giving Unitree priority when DeepSeek purchases model‑training services, and giving DeepSeek priority when Unitree looks for AI models for its humanoid robots. This lets DeepSeek participate in the robotics sector not only financially but also through model‑hardware integration.

When Unitree went public in August, its shares were priced at 150.80 yuan, raising about 6.1 billion yuan and valuing the company at roughly $90 million, making it one of China’s first domestically listed humanoid robot manufacturers. DeepSeek’s investment in Unitree, together with leading the Winverse AI round, shows it is moving from pure AI model development toward investing in companies that apply those models to physical machines.

The key challenge for the humanoid robot industry is not just hardware manufacturing but enabling robots to understand human language, recognize unfamiliar environments, and translate abstract commands into reliable actions. Large language models excel at text comprehension, content generation, and knowledge processing, but enabling robots to perform tasks like moving, grasping, walking, and factory work also requires visual perception, spatial reasoning, motion planning, and real‑time control.

Winverse AI is targeting exactly this technology gap. If it can build models that understand natural‑language commands, observe surroundings, and execute complex motions, it could move humanoid robots from limited demo settings into factories, warehouses, and other multi‑step work environments. However, such models must still overcome real‑world uncertainties such as shifting object positions, unexpected obstacles, motion errors, and safety controls.

China has built a fairly complete hardware manufacturing and supply‑chain ecosystem for robots, but AI technology that gives robots general understanding and action capability remains a major competitive gap. By investing in Winverse AI, DeepSeek is putting money into a field that complements its existing model strengths, hoping that specialized teams and hardware partners will shorten the path from digital AI applications to physical operations.

Several U.S. startups are also pursuing general‑purpose robot AI. Skild AI is reportedly valued at about $14 billion and Physical Intelligence at roughly $5.6 billion, both backed by Nvidia (NVDA‑US) and Alphabet (GOOGL‑US). In contrast, Winverse AI is still in a seed round with a post‑money valuation of about $400 million, much lower but pursuing a similar goal of creating a universal AI brain that can support various robot hardware.

The funding gap reflects differing financing environments in the U.S. and China. U.S. startups can tap large tech firms and venture‑capital markets, while Chinese firms face constraints from capital sources, advanced chip access, and geopolitics. DeepSeek’s recent large raise not only funds its own model training and data‑center needs but also gives it more resources to invest in specialized AI teams and co‑development projects.

For DeepSeek, investing in Winverse AI does not mean it already has a mature robot product or that the technology has been commercially validated. The deal is still tentative, and Winverse AI’s product timeline, technical performance, and revenue potential remain to be confirmed. Nonetheless, moving from investing in Unitree to leading Winverse AI shows DeepSeek’s strategy is expanding from language models to embodied intelligence, mirroring the AI industry’s shift from text generation to systems that understand real‑world environments, plan actions, and get work done.

items.title: 全球最大資管吹起債市號角！貝萊德六年來首次看多短天期美債　下調美股評等
items.title_en: World's Largest Asset Manager Sounds the Bond Market Horn! BlackRock First Bullish on Short-Term US Treasuries in Six Years, Downgrades US Equity Rating
paras: 全球最大資產管理公司貝萊德旗下投資研究所調整美國資產配置，結束近六年美債低配立場，短期美債調升至超配，長期美債由低配調至中性，同時把長期維持超配的美股降至中性，機構抵押貸款證券(MBS)亦降至中性，並削減日本國債低配部位。
貝萊德策略師Jean Boivin、Wei Li及全球固定收益投資長Rick Rieder出具最新研報指出，美債殖利率已攀升至具吸引力水準，市場對Fed進一步緊縮的預期可能過度。
貝萊德自2020年10月首次低配美債，當時10年債殖利率約0.9%，其後受經濟韌性、資本需求、油價與中東情勢推升通膨擔憂影響，基準殖利率一度升至5.2％以上。
貝萊德認為，殖利率已朝向「長期更高利率」觀點重置，可鎖定收益；若利率互換市場所反映的未來12個月至少三次、各升息1碼押注降溫，短債可受起始高殖利率與預期修正雙重支撐。
根據貝萊德測算，未來12個月美債殖利率需再調升約3碼，總回報才會轉負。
美股下調被歸因於「AI建設帶來的潛在波動」。對此貝萊德強調，此舉係管理近期風險，非改變AI核心看法，仍看好AI相關企業及上市基礎設施，但高利率使企業創造高於資本成本回報的能力更關鍵，融資成本上升將放大個股報酬差異。
與此同時。PIMCO高級組合顧問Rupert Harrison說，整體債券組合久期已達「很長一段時間以來最長」。貝萊德表示，待能見度改善、出現合適切入點，將重新加碼風險資產
paras_en: BlackRock, the world's largest asset manager, has adjusted its U.S. asset allocation, ending nearly six years of underweighting U.S. Treasuries. It now moves short‑term Treasuries to an overweight position, shifts long‑term Treasuries from underweight to neutral, reduces its long‑term overweight stance on U.S. equities to neutral, brings mortgage‑backed securities (MBS) to neutral, and trims its underweight position in Japanese government bonds.

BlackRock strategists Jean Boivin, Wei Li, and global fixed‑income chief Rick Rieder noted in a new research note that Treasury yields have risen to attractive levels and that market expectations of further Fed tightening may be overstated.

BlackRock first moved to an underweight stance on Treasuries in October 2020, when the 10‑year yield was about 0.9%. Since then, stronger‑than‑expected economic resilience, capital demand, oil prices, and Middle‑East tensions have pushed inflation concerns higher, lifting the benchmark yield to above 5.2% at one point.

BlackRock believes yields are resetting toward a "higher‑for‑longer" outlook, which can lock in returns. If the interest‑rate swap market’s implied scenario of at least three 1‑basis‑point hikes over the next 12 months cools, short‑term bonds can be supported by both the high starting yields and the expected correction.
According to BlackRock’s calculations, Treasury yields would need to rise another roughly 3 basis points over the next 12 months for total returns to turn negative.

The downgrade of U.S. equities is attributed to "potential volatility from AI construction." BlackRock emphasized that this move is about managing near‑term risk, not a change in its core view on AI; it remains bullish on AI‑related companies and the underlying infrastructure. However, higher rates make a company's ability to generate returns above its cost of capital more critical, and rising financing costs will amplify differences in individual stock performance.

At the same time, PIMCO senior portfolio advisor Rupert Harrison said the overall bond portfolio duration is now at "its longest in a very long time." BlackRock added that once visibility improves and a suitable entry point emerges, it will increase exposure to risk assets again.

items.title: 諾貝爾經濟學獎揭曉 兩美國學者揭示央行對抗通膨關鍵
items.title_en: Nobel Prize in Economics Announced: Two American Scholars Reveal Key to Central Banks' Fight Against Inflation
paras: 2026 年諾貝爾經濟學獎得主揭曉，美國經濟學家霍爾（Robert E. Hall）和伍德福（Michael Woodford）共同獲獎，表彰兩人為宏觀經濟穩定政策奠定微觀基礎的開創性貢獻。
瑞典皇家科學院周一(12日)宣布，將今年諾貝爾經濟學獎頒給史丹佛大學教授霍爾及哥倫比亞大學教授伍德福。
兩位學者將家庭與企業的決策行為納入宏觀經濟模型，重新詮釋凱因斯主義，為央行與政府應對通膨、經濟衰退及能源危機提供更完整的理論架構。
經濟學獎委員會主席 John Hassler 表示，兩人的研究有助於政策制定者理解經濟衝擊，並更有效地評估財政與貨幣政策的影響。
霍爾 1943 年出生於美國加州帕洛阿爾托，1967 年取得麻省理工學院博士學位；伍德福 1955 年出生於麻薩諸塞州奇科皮，1983 年取得麻省理工學院博士學位。
傳統凱因斯理論遭遇挑戰 1970年代滯脹成轉捩點
凱因斯主義興起後，透過逆週期政策穩定經濟逐漸成為主流思維。當經濟衰退時，政府可擴大財政支出、央行降低利率；經濟過熱時，則採取相反措施。
然而，1970 年代石油危機引發的滯脹，讓傳統宏觀經濟理論面臨重大挑戰。當時經濟成長放緩、失業率攀升，通膨卻同步走高，與傳統模型預期的通膨和失業率反向關係不符。
過去的凱因斯主義模型主要依賴通膨、消費、失業率及產出等總體變數之間的統計關係，例如失業率上升通常伴隨通膨下降，家庭所得增加則帶動消費成長。
但這些關係並非始終穩定，一旦經濟環境或政策改變，原有統計規律可能失效，削弱模型預測政策效果的可靠性。
霍爾與伍德福的研究，正是試圖從家庭和企業的個別決策出發，解釋宏觀經濟變化背後的運作機制，回應傳統模型缺乏穩固微觀基礎的問題。
霍爾重新解釋消費行為 未來預期成關鍵
霍爾的重要貢獻之一，是重新檢視家庭如何決定消費與儲蓄。
他在 1978 年提出，若家庭根據對未來收入的預期安排消費，在沒有新資訊改變預期的情況下，消費變化就不應能被系統性預測。
這項研究意味著，家庭消費不只是當期所得的反映，也與人們對未來收入的判斷密切相關。
1982 年，霍爾與經濟學家 Fredric Mishkin 進一步利用家庭微觀資料研究，發現約 80% 的樣本家庭，其消費決策符合相關理論，其餘家庭則較接近「量入為出」模式，消費直接受到當期收入及可動用資金限制。
這些研究協助經濟學家區分不同家庭的消費行為，也為後續宏觀經濟模型建立重要基礎。
伍德福建立新凱因斯模型 連結利率、產出與通膨
伍德福則進一步將家庭消費、企業定價及市場預期整合進新凱因斯主義宏觀經濟模型。
2003 年，他在相關著作中系統性闡述由三個核心方程式構成的分析架構，用以解釋利率如何影響經濟產出與通膨，以及央行應如何運用貨幣政策穩定物價。
模型強調，家庭消費受到未來收入與利率預期影響，企業定價則取決於生產成本、市場需求及未來價格走勢。
由於企業不會隨著成本或需求變化立即調整售價，價格具有一定僵固性，使需求變動得以影響實際產出與通膨。
伍德福也將「產出缺口」納入分析，用以衡量實際產出與自然產出之間的差距。
當產出缺口為正，代表需求相對強勁，可能推升通膨；若產出缺口為負，則反映需求不足。央行可據此判斷經濟情勢，調整利率政策。
政策預期影響經濟 央行溝通成重要工具
兩位學者的研究也凸顯，貨幣政策的影響不僅來自實際利率調整，還包括家庭與企業對未來政策的預期。
例如，央行除了透過升降息改變借貸成本，也能藉由說明未來政策方向，影響民眾對通膨、收入及利率的判斷，進而改變消費、儲蓄與投資決策。
這也為現代央行廣泛使用的「前瞻性指引」提供理論支持，使政策溝通成為貨幣政策傳導的重要環節。
從能源危機到通膨衝擊 為政策決策提供依據
兩人的研究也有助於解釋，為何能源價格飆升可能同時造成通膨上升與經濟產出下降。
當能源成本快速增加，企業生產成本上升，經濟潛在產出可能受到壓抑；若需求未同步減弱，通膨壓力便可能進一步擴大。
面對這類供給衝擊，央行必須在經濟成長與物價穩定之間取得平衡，而不能僅依賴傳統通膨與失業率的統計關係制定政策。
如今，新凱因斯主義模型已廣泛應用於各國央行及財政部門，並可依不同經濟結構進行調整。
霍爾與伍德福的研究雖然無法消除經濟衰退或高通膨，卻讓政策制定者能從家庭、企業及市場預期出發，更有系統地理解經濟波動與政策傳導機制，為現代宏觀經濟穩定政策奠定更扎實的理論基礎。
paras_en: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Economics laureates have been announced, with American economists Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford jointly receiving the award in recognition of their pioneering contributions that laid a micro‑foundational basis for macroeconomic stabilization policy.

The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences announced on Monday (the 12th) that this year’s Nobel Prize in Economics will be awarded to Stanford University professor Hall and Columbia University professor Woodford.

The two scholars incorporated household and firm decision‑making into macroeconomic models, re‑interpreting Keynesianism and providing a more complete theoretical framework for central banks and governments to address inflation, recession and the energy crisis.
Economics Prize Committee chair John Hassler said the researchers’ work helps policymakers understand economic shocks and more effectively assess the impact of fiscal and monetary policies.
Hall was born in 1943 in Palo Alto, California, and earned his Ph.D. from MIT in 1967; Woodford was born in 1955 in Chicopee, Massachusetts, and received his MIT doctorate in 1983.
Traditional Keynesian theory faced a turning point in the 1970s as stagflation emerged.

After the rise of Keynesianism, counter‑cyclical policies to stabilize the economy became mainstream thinking: governments could increase spending and central banks could cut rates during downturns, and do the opposite when the economy overheated.

However, the oil‑price shocks of the 1970s produced stagflation, challenging conventional macro theory. Growth slowed, unemployment rose, and inflation surged simultaneously, contradicting the traditional inverse relationship between inflation and unemployment predicted by standard models.

Earlier Keynesian models relied on statistical relationships among aggregate variables such as inflation, consumption, unemployment and output—for example, higher unemployment was usually associated with lower inflation, and rising household income spurred consumption growth.

These relationships are not always stable; when the economic environment or policy changes, the underlying statistical regularities can break down, weakening the model’s ability to predict policy effects reliably.

Hall and Woodford’s research seeks to start from the individual decisions of households and firms to explain the mechanisms behind macroeconomic fluctuations, addressing the lack of a solid micro foundation in traditional models.
Hall Re‑examines Consumption Behavior: Future Expectations Are Key
One of Hall’s major contributions is a fresh look at how households decide on consumption and saving.

In 1978 he argued that if families plan consumption based on expectations of future income, then in the absence of new information that changes those expectations, consumption changes should not be systematically predictable.
This insight implies that household consumption reflects not only current income but also people’s judgments about future earnings.

In 1982 Hall, together with economist Frederic Mishkin, used micro‑level household data and found that about 80 % of the sample families made consumption decisions consistent with the theory, while the remaining households behaved more like “hand‑to‑mouth” spenders, with consumption directly constrained by current income and liquid assets.
These studies helped economists differentiate consumption patterns across households and provided an important building block for subsequent macro models.
Woodford Builds a New Keynesian Model Linking Interest Rates, Output and Inflation
Woodford further integrated household consumption, firm pricing and market expectations into a New Keynesian macroeconomic framework.

In 2003 he systematically presented an analytical structure composed of three core equations to explain how interest rates affect output and inflation, and how central banks should use monetary policy to stabilize prices.

The model emphasizes that household consumption is influenced by expectations of future income and interest rates, while firm pricing depends on production costs, market demand and anticipated future price movements.
Because firms do not adjust prices instantly in response to cost or demand changes, prices exhibit rigidity, allowing demand fluctuations to affect real output and inflation.
Woodford also incorporated the “output gap” into his analysis as a measure of the difference between actual output and potential (natural) output.

A positive output gap signals strong demand that may push inflation higher; a negative gap reflects insufficient demand. Central banks can gauge economic conditions from this gap and adjust interest‑rate policy accordingly.
Policy Expectations Shape the Economy: Central‑Bank Communication Becomes a Crucial Tool
The scholars’ work also highlights that monetary policy’s impact comes not only from actual interest‑rate changes but also from households’ and firms’ expectations about future policy.

For example, beyond raising or lowering rates to alter borrowing costs, a central bank can influence public judgments about inflation, income and rates by communicating its future policy stance, thereby affecting consumption, saving and investment decisions.
This provides theoretical support for the modern practice of “forward guidance,” making policy communication an important channel of monetary‑policy transmission.
From Energy Crises to Inflation Shocks: Providing a Basis for Policy Decisions
Their research also helps explain why soaring energy prices can simultaneously raise inflation and depress economic output.
When energy costs rise sharply, firms’ production costs increase and potential output may be constrained; if demand does not fall correspondingly, inflationary pressure can intensify further.
Facing such supply‑side shocks, central banks must balance growth and price stability and cannot rely solely on traditional statistical links between inflation and unemployment when setting policy.
Today the New Keynesian model is widely used by central banks and fiscal authorities around the world and can be adapted to different economic structures.

Although Hall and Woodford’s work cannot eliminate recessions or high inflation, it enables policymakers to start from household, firm and market expectations and understand economic fluctuations and policy transmission more systematically, laying a sturdier theoretical foundation for modern macroeconomic stabilization policy.

items.title: AI股財報門檻拉高！高估值股本益比收縮幅度達低價股100倍 市場緊盯獲利能否支撐身價
items.title_en: AI Stock Valuation Threshold Rises: High‑P/E Shrinkage Reaches 100× That of Low‑Priced Stocks, Market Watches Whether Earnings Can Sustain Prices
paras: 美股財報季進入關鍵時刻，尤其是人工智慧(AI)概念股，目前市場上估值最高有一部分股票近期出現異常劇烈的估值下修，讓本季財報表現變得更加重要。
華爾街預期，企業獲利將再度強勁成長一季，但Trivariate Research警告，獲利成長不一定能轉化為股價上漲，尤其對估值最高的股票而言更是如此。

高估值股票本益比收縮幅度是低價股百倍

Trivariate Research分析師發現，以第2季末的預估本益比衡量，估值最高的股票在第3季的本益比收縮幅度，約為估值最低股票的100倍。超微(AMD-US)、邁威爾(MRVL-US)、康寧(GLW-US)及Bloom Energy(BE-US)等熱門AI概念股，都名列這波估值下修最劇烈的股票之列。
Trivariate Research說：「自1999年以來，估值前10%股票本益比收縮幅度超過今年第3季的情況，只占5.3%的時間。」
估值下修不只發生在最昂貴的股票身上，但這些股票遭遇的重新定價最為劇烈。根據道瓊市場數據，儘管今年企業獲利強勁成長，標普500指數(SPX)的預估本益比仍從2026年初的22倍，降至上周末的19倍。

AI資本支出受惠股未獲市場充分肯定

有一派認為，這反映投資人對AI交易的信心正在減弱。22V負責數據與基礎設施分析的Dauvin Peterson表示，最受惠於AI資本支出的股票，對於預期中的未來獲利「幾乎沒有獲得市場認可」，導致估值受到壓縮。
不過，SimCorp全球投資決策研究主管Melissa Brown表示，儘管市場對AI交易的疑慮升高，近期估值下修的主要驅動因素仍是高殖利率，而且AI相關企業受到的衝擊更大。
她解釋：「利率會影響所有企業為營運融資的能力，但AI企業目前有大量資金需求，必須投入基礎設施建置，因此特別容易受到影響。」
她進一步指出：「市場開始質疑，營收何時才能足以支付如今更高的支出，甚至懷疑營收是否終究能夠做到。當然，這些企業原本的估值就比較高，因此相較其他公司，下修空間也更大。」
美國公債殖利率近來攀升至數十年高點。10年期公債殖利率升至2002年以來最高水準，超越2007年創下的前一波高點。
當殖利率居高不下，投資人就更不願意為未來獲利支付高額溢價。換言之，投機性較高的股票，相較於其長期獲利潛力，正以大幅折價交易。
Aon全球投資長Russ Ivinjack表示，雖然近年來的投資人通常願意為未來成長支付溢價，但殖利率持續走高，正讓投資人提高要求。
他說：「企業仍然可以享有估值溢價，但必須愈來愈有能力證明其合理性。這種市場變化，正導致估值最昂貴的股票族群出現本益比收縮。」

AI股財報門檻升高 企業須證明估值合理

巴隆周刊(Barrpn’s)指出，這代表本季財報季的市場門檻已經拉高，AI概念股尤其如此：企業不僅需要交出強勁業績，還必須說服投資人，自己的成長前景足以支撐目前估值。
在這波多頭行情中經歷大幅上漲後，AI股票如今需要提出更多證據，證明高估值具有合理性。
paras_en: The U.S. earnings season has entered a critical phase, especially for artificial‑intelligence (AI) concept stocks. Some of the highest‑valued shares in the market have recently undergone extreme valuation cuts, making this quarter’s earnings performance even more important.

Wall Street expects corporate profits to grow strongly again this quarter, but Trivariate Research warns that profit growth does not necessarily translate into higher stock prices, especially for the most highly valued shares.

The shrinkage of the price‑to‑earnings ratio for high‑valuation stocks is 100 times that of low‑priced stocks. Trivariate Research analysts found that, measured by the P/E ratio at the end of Q2, the most highly valued stocks saw a P/E contraction in Q3 that was about 100 times that of the lowest‑valued stocks. Popular AI concept stocks such as AMD‑US, MRVL‑US, GLW‑US, and BE‑US were among the most sharply re‑priced shares.
Trivariate Research said: "Since 1999, the top 10% of stocks by valuation have had a P/E contraction exceeding this year’s Q3 only 5.3% of the time."

Valuation cuts are not limited to the most expensive stocks, but those shares experience the most severe re‑pricing. According to Dow Jones market data, even though corporate earnings have grown strongly this year, the S&P 500’s estimated P/E fell from 22× at the beginning of 2026 to 19× at the end of last week.

Some argue that this reflects a waning confidence in AI trading. Dauvin Peterson, head of data and infrastructure analysis at 22V, said that the stocks most benefited by AI capital expenditures have "almost received no market recognition" for the expected future earnings, leading to compressed valuations.

However, Melissa Brown, head of global investment decision research at SimCorp, said that despite rising doubts about AI trading, the main driver of recent valuation cuts remains high dividend yields, and AI‑related companies are hit harder.

She explained: "Interest rates affect all companies’ ability to finance operations, but AI companies currently have large capital needs and must invest in infrastructure, making them especially vulnerable."

She further pointed out: "The market is questioning when revenue will be sufficient to cover the higher costs, even doubting whether revenue can ultimately keep up. Naturally, these companies had higher initial valuations, so the room for cuts is larger compared to other firms."
U.S. Treasury yields have recently climbed to multi‑decade highs. The 10‑year Treasury yield has risen to its highest level since 2002, surpassing the previous peak set in 2007.

When yields remain high, investors are less willing to pay a premium for future earnings. In other words, speculative stocks are trading at steep discounts relative to their long‑term earnings potential.

Russ Ivinjack, global investment chief at Aon, said that although investors have been willing to pay a premium for future growth in recent years, the rising yields are forcing them to raise their expectations.
He said: "Companies can still enjoy valuation premiums, but they must increasingly prove their rationality. This market shift is causing the most expensive stocks to see P/E contraction."

Barron's noted that this means the market threshold for this quarter’s earnings season has risen, especially for AI concept stocks: companies must not only deliver strong results but also convince investors that their growth prospects justify the current valuation.
In this bullish market, after experiencing significant gains, AI stocks now need to provide more evidence to prove that their high valuations are justified.

items.title: 戰爭紅利持續釋放 全球超大型油輪運費漲到60年來最高
items.title_en: War Bonuses Keep Unfolding as Global VLCC Freight Rates Surge to 60-Year High
paras: 美伊衝突升級後，能源、軍工、航運、替代能源等多個產業直接獲得明確業績與發展紅利。
中東戰事延宕大幅拉升長距離原油運輸剛需，加上船隊供給嚴重短缺，目前全球超大型油輪（VLCC）運費已飆升至60年來最高水準。
超大型油輪是全球遠洋原油運輸的絕對主力，典型船長約330～340公尺，型寬約60公尺，滿載吃水深度超過20公尺，單次可運載約‌200萬桶原油‌，單桶原油的遠洋運輸成本比中小型油輪低40%以上。
荷蘭國際集團最新報告指出，以一艘9月從沙烏地阿拉伯出發前往荷蘭的油輪為例，運費折算後相當於每桶原油運輸成本達35美元，超過原油價格三分之一，去年同期均值僅2美元。時序進入今年10月，油輪運費依舊高漲。
在此帶動下，海運產業薪資‌整體呈現結構性上漲態勢‌，主要集中在船員、核心造船技術崗、海事綠色等專業崗。部分承擔荷姆茲海峽航行任務的油輪船長，月薪已漲至10萬美元，普通船員薪酬達到正常水準的4～6倍。
未來2、3年船員和核心技術崗的薪資仍有進一步上行空間。國際勞工組織已達成全球統一漲薪協議：熟練水手最低工資標準從2026年1月1日起上調至‌690美元/月‌，2027年進一步漲到704美元/月，2028年升至715美元/月。
有美國船舶經紀商指出，即便經通膨調整，當前運費也已是上世紀60年代超大型油輪問世以來最高紀錄。
部分船齡10年左右的二手超大型油輪成交價已突破1.5億美元，高於當前1.35億美元左右的新船平均造價，出現船價倒掛行情。買家甘願支付高額溢價，只為鎖定可馬上投入營運的現貨運力。
船價倒掛的核心原因是新舊船交付周期差異：訂造新船需要等待建造交付，購買二手船可即刻投入航線營運、承接貨運訂單，賺取高額運費。
雖然中東原油出口已逐步恢復，但貿易流程遠比戰前複雜。
中東產油國越來越依賴在海上進行「船對船」轉運，每次轉運往往額外增加約一周航行時間，進一步拉長了全球船隊周轉周期。而中東局勢導致荷姆茲海峽通航狀況反覆變化更是加劇這一困境。
paras_en: After the escalation of the US‑Iran conflict, sectors such as energy, defense, shipping and alternative energy are directly reaping clear performance and development bonuses.

The prolonged Middle‑East fighting has dramatically increased the demand for long‑distance crude oil transport, and with a severe shortage of vessels, global VLCC (Very Large Crude Carrier) freight rates have jumped to their highest level in six decades.

VLCCs are the absolute backbone of worldwide deep‑sea crude transport, typically about 330‑340 metres long, 60 metres wide, with a fully‑laden draft exceeding 20 metres, capable of carrying roughly 2 million barrels of oil per voyage, and their per‑barrel ocean freight cost is more than 40% lower than that of medium‑ and small‑size tankers.

A recent report from the Dutch International Group shows that a tanker departing Saudi Arabia for the Netherlands in September incurred a freight cost equivalent to $35 per barrel – over one‑third of the crude price – compared with an average of just $2 a year ago. Even by October this year, tanker freight remains sky‑high.

This surge is driving a structural rise in wages across the maritime industry, especially for crew members, core shipbuilding‑technology positions and maritime‑green specialties. Some VLCC captains operating the Hormuz Strait now earn monthly salaries of $100,000, while ordinary crew members are paid four to six times the normal rate.

Salaries for crew and core‑technology roles are expected to keep climbing over the next two to three years. The International Labour Organization has reached a global wage‑increase agreement: the minimum wage for skilled seafarers will rise to $690 per month starting 1 January 2026, then to $704 in 2027 and $715 in 2028.
U.S. ship brokers note that even after adjusting for inflation, current freight rates are the highest on record since VLCCs first entered service in the 1960s.

Second‑hand VLCCs about ten years old are now selling for over $150 million, surpassing the roughly $135 million average cost of new builds, creating a price‑inversion market. Buyers are willing to pay a premium simply to lock in vessels that can be put into service immediately.

The core reason for the price inversion is the delivery gap between new and old ships: ordering a new build requires a waiting period for construction and delivery, whereas buying a used vessel allows instant deployment on routes and the ability to capture high freight rates.
Although Middle‑East crude exports are gradually resuming, the trade process is far more complex than before the war.

Oil‑producing countries in the Middle East are increasingly relying on "ship‑to‑ship" transfers at sea, each adding roughly a week of sailing time and further extending the global fleet turnover cycle. The volatile navigation conditions in the Hormuz Strait due to the regional situation exacerbate this challenge.

items.title: 美光庫藏股加碼！睽違兩年解禁 分析師：比同業更大方回饋股東 未來不排除擴大
paras: 記憶體大廠美光(MU-US)投資人正等待該公司睽違兩年的庫藏股計畫，一名分析師表示，從董事會上周五將授權總額增至351.6億美元來看，美光展現出比同業更願意回饋股東的心。
美光在上周五提交的10-K年度報告中表示，董事會已額外授權330億美元的庫藏股計畫，使庫藏股授權總額增至351.6億美元。美光在2024年獲得美國《晶片與科學法案》(Chips and Science Act)資金，因此被限制必須等到今年12月才能再次買回自家股票。
TD Cowen分析師Krish Sankar表示，考量到美光在記憶體市場的市占率低於南韓競爭對手SK海力士(SKHY-US)，他原本預期美光此次新增的庫藏股授權金額較低，約為200億美元。SK海力士目前已授權約290億美元的庫藏股計畫。
Sankar認為，美光此舉「是為了吸引更多資金，並展現美光在審慎進行長期資本配置的同時，能比海力士更照顧股東」。

庫藏股規模仍低於單季毛利 未來不排除再加碼

Sankar指出，美光目前約351.6億美元的庫藏股授權總額，仍低於該公司最近一季約470億美元的毛利。相較之下，美光上一次在2018年5月授權100億美元庫藏股，金額約為當時兩季加總起來的毛利。
因此，與過去的庫藏股計畫相比，美光如今「獲利能力已大幅提升」，而且與客戶之間採取新的長約機制，更能明確掌握客戶需求。Sankar認為，這代表美光未來仍有空間進一步增加庫藏股授權額度。
雖然在記憶體供應吃緊下，美光得以提高零組件價格，但Sankar預測，相關產品價格可能在2027年第3季開始下滑。
現階段，他認為美光對業務的能見度仍將持續改善，而提高股東資本回報，也可能為公司帶來更高估值。

輝達營收占比下降 反映其他客戶成長更快

Sankar進一步指出，美光截至本會計年度第2季(2026年3月底止)為止，已經連續六季出現輝達(NVDA-US)在單季營收占比超過10%的情況，反映輝達積極採購高頻寬記憶體(HBM)。
雖然這個連續紀錄暫時中止，但Sankar表示，這不代表輝達對美光的重要性下降，而是因為「美光的其他客戶成長得更快」。
美光周一(12日)收低3.9%，反映整體晶片類股普遍走弱，主因是《南華早報》一則報導披露，中國記憶體廠長鑫存儲(CXMT)據傳在提高單顆晶片記憶體密度的技術上取得「關鍵進展」。

items.title: 葉門胡塞再襲沙烏地阿拉伯首都機場 攻擊空軍基地
items.title_en: Yemen's Houthis Launch Another Attack on Saudi Arabia's Capital Airport, Strike Air Force Base
paras: 葉門叛軍胡塞12日（周一）說，當天向沙烏地阿拉伯首都利雅德哈立德國王國際機場發射一枚彈道飛彈，並出動無人機襲擊沙國西南部一處空軍基地。
胡塞發言人葉海亞·薩雷亞當天在社交媒體發表聲明，稱12日晚向哈立德國王國際機場發射的飛彈命中目標。
胡塞還使用無人機襲擊了位於沙國西南部海米斯穆謝特的哈立德國王空軍基地，無人機也命中目標。
薩雷亞再次警告國際航空公司、航空從業人員及旅客不要使用沙國境內的機場和領空，稱除麥加和麥地那的機場及空域外，沙國機場均「不安全」。
近日胡塞連續襲擊沙國境內的機場和石油設施。沙國主導的多國聯軍則表示，正展開大規模軍事行動，打擊胡塞人員及其軍事能力，著力瓦解彈道飛彈網絡，並全天候為葉門政府軍提供空中支援。
paras_en: On Monday, the Yemeni rebel group Houthis said they launched a ballistic missile at King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, the capital of Saudi Arabia, and deployed drones to attack an air force base in the kingdom's southwest on the same day.
Houthis spokesperson Yahya Saree issued a statement on social media that the missile fired at King Khalid International Airport on the evening of the 12th hit its target.
The Houthis also used drones to strike King Khalid Air Base in Hemeis Mushait in southwestern Saudi Arabia, with the drones reportedly hitting their target.

Saree warned international airlines, aviation personnel and travelers not to use Saudi airports or airspace, stating that, apart from the airports and airspace of Mecca and Medina, all Saudi airports are "unsafe".

In recent days the Houthis have repeatedly attacked Saudi airports and oil facilities. The Saudi‑led multinational coalition said it is conducting large‑scale military operations to target Houthi personnel and capabilities, aiming to dismantle the ballistic missile network and provide round‑the‑clock air support to Yemen's government forces.

items.title: 高盛喊人民幣遭嚴重低估 預測一年內升至6.4元

paras: 高盛集團(GS-US) 外匯、利率及新興市場策略研究全球主管 Kamakshya Trivedi 表示，在每日交易額高達9.5兆美元的全球外匯市場中，人民幣走升是目前市場上最被低估的情境之一。
高盛估計，人民幣目前遭低估約 20% 至 25%，Trivedi 認為，這項估計仍屬「保守」。他指出，中國持續擴大的貿易順差，進一步強化人民幣升值的理由。
Trivedi 上週接受訪問時表示，高盛預期，未來一年人民幣兌美元人民幣/美元(CNYUSD) 匯率將從目前約 6.69 元升至 6.40 元，而根據該行的公允價值衡量指標，未來人民幣甚至可能升至6元左右。
人民幣上一次接近兌美元 6 元水準，是在 2014 年初，當時中國正經歷大量熱錢快速流入。
Trivedi 表示：「人們低估了人民幣可能升值的幅度。每當我們上調人民幣匯率預測時，市場共識與遠期市場仍未跟上調整的程度，都讓我感到意外。」
他補充說：「我們的看法非常簡單，人民幣升值將是漸進的過程，但這個趨勢會持續下去。」
人民幣遭低估20%至25% 貿易順差強化升值理由
高盛提出上述觀點之際，中國正面臨歐洲國家等主要貿易夥伴日益強烈的批評，指控北京透過人為壓低人民幣匯率來刺激出口。
北京則否認相關指控，強調匯率調整無法解決全球經濟的結構性失衡問題，並指出中國出口競爭力的提升，來自工業競爭力持續增強。
儘管中國當局已允許人民幣兌多數主要貨幣升值，且在嚴格管理的匯率制度下，人民幣兌美元已升至四年高點，但國際社會要求人民幣進一步升值的壓力仍持續增加。
在地緣政治緊張局勢與通膨居高不下推動美元反彈之際，人民幣成為少數仍有望持續升值的貨幣之一。
Trivedi指出，若進一步考量中國經常帳及對外收支表現，人民幣遭低估的程度將顯得「大得多」。
中國官方數據顯示，今年前八個月，中國貿易順差達 8,055 億美元。Trivedi表示：「因此，在我看來，毫無疑問，人民幣匯率明顯遭到低估。」
中國對人民幣升值態度轉變 維持貿易穩定成關鍵
Trivedi 認為，中國決策官員可能正逐漸接受人民幣進一步升值，部分原因在於維持穩定貿易關係的重要性。
中國與歐盟經過談判後，同意限制油電混合車出口，避免雙方爆發更廣泛的貿易摩擦。相關談判已於上週五結束。今年以來，人民幣兌歐元已升值超過 8%。
北京對人民幣走強的接受度提高，也反映中國出口產業結構正在轉變，尖端科技與先進製造業逐漸成為出口成長的主要動力。
Trivedi 表示：「即使從中國自身的角度來看，我認為他們最重視的仍是貿易關係的穩定。」
他進一步指出：「貿易關係維持穩定的時間愈長，我認為中國就愈能認知到，人民幣適度升值符合其基本總體經濟情勢。」
彭博市場策略師 Andre de Silva 則指出，中國作為全球資金提供者的角色日益重要，標誌著人民幣國際化進入新階段。
人民幣的影響力正從貿易結算與支付，進一步擴展至全球借貸、投資及避險市場。
人民幣穩步升值 有助推動國際化
Trivedi 也認為，人民幣走強符合北京提升人民幣國際地位的目標。
中國國家主席習近平先前曾承諾，將人民幣打造為強勢貨幣，使其廣泛應用於國際貿易、投資及外匯市場，並取得全球儲備貨幣地位。
Trivedi 表示：「我認為，溫和、漸進但持續的升值，也有助於實現人民幣國際化的目標。」
他補充說，人民幣升值也將使中國資產的投資報酬前景更具吸引力。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs Group (GS-US) global head of foreign exchange, rates and emerging markets strategy research, Kamakshya Trivedi, said that in the worldwide FX market with a daily turnover of up to $9.5 trillion, the appreciation of the renminbi is one of the most undervalued scenarios currently.

Goldman estimates the renminbi is presently undervalued by about 20% to 25%, and Trivedi believes this estimate is still “conservative.” He points to China’s continuously expanding trade surplus as further strengthening the case for RMB appreciation.

Trivedi told reporters last week that Goldman expects the RMB/USD exchange rate to move from roughly 6.69 today to 6.40 within a year, and according to the bank’s fair‑value metric the renminbi could even reach around 6.00 in the future.
The last time the renminbi approached the 6‑to‑1 level against the dollar was in early 2014, when China was experiencing a massive influx of hot money.

Trivedi said: “People underestimate how much the renminbi could appreciate. Every time we raise our RMB forecast, the market consensus and forward market lag behind the adjustment, which surprises me.”
He added: “Our view is simple – RMB appreciation will be a gradual process, but the trend will continue.”
Renminbi undervalued 20%‑25% – trade surplus reinforces appreciation case
Goldman voiced these views as China faces increasingly strong criticism from major trading partners such as European countries, accusing Beijing of artificially depressing the RMB to boost exports.

Beijing denies the allegations, emphasizing that exchange‑rate adjustments cannot solve the structural imbalances in the global economy and noting that China’s export competitiveness stems from a continuously strengthening industrial base.

Although Chinese authorities have allowed the renminbi to appreciate against most major currencies and, under a tightly managed regime, the RMB‑USD rate has risen to a four‑year high, international pressure for further appreciation remains strong.
Amid geopolitical tensions and persistently high inflation driving a dollar rebound, the renminbi is one of the few currencies still expected to keep appreciating.
Trivedi noted that if China’s current‑account and external‑balance performance are taken into account, the degree of RMB undervaluation would appear “much larger.”

Official Chinese data show that in the first eight months of this year the trade surplus reached $805.5 billion. Trivedi said: “Therefore, in my view there is no doubt the RMB exchange rate is clearly undervalued.”
China’s stance on RMB appreciation shifts – maintaining trade stability remains key
Trivedi believes Chinese policymakers may be gradually accepting further RMB appreciation, partly because maintaining stable trade relations is crucial.

After negotiations with the EU, China agreed to limit exports of hybrid electric vehicles to avoid broader trade frictions. The talks concluded last Friday, and the renminbi has appreciated more than 8% against the euro so far this year.
Beijing’s greater acceptance of a stronger RMB also reflects a structural shift in China’s export industries, with high‑tech and advanced manufacturing becoming the main drivers of export growth.
Trivedi said: “Even from China’s own perspective, I think the thing they value most is the stability of trade relations.”
He further noted: “The longer trade relations remain stable, the more China will recognize that a modest RMB appreciation fits its overall macroeconomic conditions.”
Bloomberg market strategist Andre de Silva pointed out that China’s role as a global capital provider is becoming increasingly important, marking a new stage in RMB internationalisation.
The renminbi’s influence is expanding from trade settlement and payments to global borrowing, investment and hedging markets.
Steady RMB appreciation helps drive its internationalisation
Trivedi also believes a stronger renminbi aligns with Beijing’s goal of raising the currency’s international status.

Chinese President Xi Jinping has previously pledged to make the renminbi a strong currency widely used in international trade, investment and foreign‑exchange markets, and to achieve global reserve‑currency status.
Trivedi said: “I think a gentle, gradual yet sustained appreciation also helps achieve the goal of RMB internationalisation.”
He added that a stronger renminbi will make the investment return outlook for Chinese assets more attractive.

items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Holds 18-Month High Amid Middle East Tensions and US Inflation Impacting Market Sentiment
paras: 美元周一(12日)維持在18個月高點，受到避險需求支撐。隨著中東地區在週末的攻擊行動升級，投資人保持謹慎，並等待本週稍晚公布的美國重要通膨數據。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.37%，報102.58，為2025年4月以來最高。
由於受到伊朗支持的葉門「青年運動」(Houthis)加大對沙烏地阿拉伯的攻擊，加上週末有兩艘油輪遭到攻擊，油價走勢震盪。
布蘭特原油期貨上漲2.3%，報每桶107.17 美元，接近兩週高點。
這些攻擊事件蓋過了美國總統川普週日宣布的俄羅斯與烏克蘭能源停火協議。該協議從一開始似乎就面臨威脅，因基輔指控莫斯科在當晚違反協議。
布蘭特原油價格目前仍比美國與以色列對伊朗開戰前高出近45%。
另一方面，克里夫蘭聯準(Fed)銀行總裁哈瑪克(Beth Hammack)週一表示，聯準會應該「相對迅速地」轉向限制性貨幣政策，以控制她認為已經擴散至更廣泛領域的通膨。
投資人持續增加美元的看漲部位。截至10月7日當週，美元看漲部位約達360億美元，較三週前的84億美元大幅增加。
LMAX Group市場策略師Joel Kruger表示，「我們不確信，這波最新的避險情緒會轉化為持續性的美元走強。」他指出，經濟數據正在降溫、通膨壓力有所緩和，而且市場已經反映聯準會預期升息的大部分影響。「我們認為美元進一步上漲的空間有限。」
市場焦點轉向美國通膨數據
週三公布的美國消費者通膨報告，是聯準會本月政策會議前最後幾項重要經濟數據之一，可能成為決定美元短期走勢的關鍵。
10月初，美國消費者信心進一步惡化。由於中東衝突推高生活成本，家庭對經濟的看法更加悲觀。
聯準會上個月升息，是自2023年以來首次升息，目的是抑制通膨。
芝商所(CME)FedWatch工具顯示，交易員目前預估聯準會本月維持利率不變的機率為78%，高於一個月前的51%。
Bannockburn Global Forex首席市場策略師 Marc Chandler表示，「本週真正焦點是消費者物價指數(CPI)數據，而通膨數字很可能仍會偏高。」他補充，聯準會在選舉前升息的情況非常罕見，因此聯準會採取行動的門檻相當高。
投資人也越來越擔心債券市場的大幅拋售。這波賣壓已經推升全球各地的借貸成本，使其升至數十年來高點。
歐元兌美元下跌0.4%，至1.1156 美元，接近17個月低點。上週歐元已連續第五週下跌，主要原因是投資人擔憂法國的財政狀況，尤其是在2027年總統大選之前。
法國10年期公債殖利率與德國公債殖利率之間的利差為140個基點。上週該利差一度接近160個基點，創2012年以來最大。
花旗集團G10外匯策略主管Dan Tobon表示，「情況沒有改善，也沒有明確的指引告訴我們，短期內要如何才能讓局勢好轉。現在有什麼理由要買進歐洲債券、買進歐元？很難找到理由，因此我們只能看著它持續走弱。」

paras_en: The dollar remained at an 18‑month high on Monday (the 12th), supported by safe‑haven demand. As attacks in the Middle East escalated over the weekend, investors stayed cautious and awaited key US inflation data due later this week.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.37% to 102.58, the highest level since April 2025.
Attacks by the Iran‑backed Yemeni “Youth Movement” (Houthis) on Saudi Arabia intensified, and two oil tankers were hit over the weekend, sending oil prices into a swing.
Brent crude futures climbed 2.3% to $107.17 a barrel, near a two‑week high.

These attacks eclipsed President Trump’s Sunday announcement of a Russia‑Ukraine energy cease‑fire agreement, which seemed threatened from the start after Kyiv accused Moscow of violating the pact that evening.
Brent prices are still roughly 45% above levels seen before the United States and Israel went to war with Iran.

On Monday, Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack said the Federal Reserve should shift “relatively quickly” to a restrictive monetary stance to curb inflation that she believes has spread to a broader range of the economy.
Investors kept adding to bullish dollar positions. As of the week ending Oct. 7, long positions on the dollar totalled about $36 billion, up sharply from $8.4 billion three weeks earlier.

LMAX Group market strategist Joel Kruger said, “We are not convinced this latest wave of safe‑haven sentiment will translate into a sustained dollar rally.” He noted that economic data are cooling, inflation pressures are easing, and markets have already priced in most of the Fed’s expected rate‑hike impact. “We think there is limited upside for the dollar,” he added.
Market focus shifts to US inflation data
Wednesday’s US consumer inflation report is one of the last major data points before the Fed’s policy meeting this month and could be decisive for the dollar’s short‑term direction.
In early October, US consumer confidence deteriorated further. Higher living costs driven by the Middle East conflict have made households more pessimistic about the economy.
The Fed’s rate hike last month was its first since 2023, aimed at taming inflation.
CME’s FedWatch tool shows traders now assign a 78% probability that the Fed will keep rates unchanged this month, up from 51% a month ago.

Marc Chandler, chief market strategist at Bannockburn Global Forex, said, “The real focus this week is the CPI data, and the inflation numbers are likely still on the high side.” He added that a pre‑election rate hike is very rare, so the Fed’s threshold for action is quite high.
Investors are also growing increasingly worried about a sharp sell‑off in the bond market. This selling pressure has pushed borrowing costs worldwide to their highest levels in decades.

The euro fell 0.4% against the dollar to $1.1156, near a 17‑month low. It has slipped for the fifth consecutive week, mainly because investors are nervous about France’s fiscal outlook ahead of the 2027 presidential election.
The spread between French 10‑year bond yields and German Bund yields stood at 140 basis points, having briefly neared 160 basis points last week – the widest gap since 2012.

Dan Tobon, head of G10 FX strategy at Citigroup, said, “The situation has not improved and there is no clear guidance on how things can get better in the short term. What reason is there now to buy European bonds or the euro? It’s hard to find any, so we can only watch it keep weakening.”
The dollar rose 0.2% against the yen to 158.66 yen.
The pound slipped 0.2% to $1.3203.

items.title: 拚科技強國也堆出債務山！中國非金融部門負債突破GDP三倍
items.title_en: Pursuing Technological Superpower Yet Piling Up Debt! China's Non‑Financial Sector Debt Exceeds Three Times GDP
paras: 中國持續透過大規模投資推進科技與軍事強國目標，債務負擔卻同步攀升，不僅壓縮國內經濟活力，也透過過剩產能與出口擴張，加深與貿易夥伴的摩擦。經濟學家指出，中國短期內未必爆發金融危機，但若繼續依賴低成本信貸支撐投資與虧損企業，金融體系恐逐漸失去效率，付出更多債務卻換不到相應成長。
據《華爾街日報》(WSJ)周一(12日)報導，國際清算銀行(BIS)資料顯示，涵蓋企業、政府及家庭借款的中國非金融部門信用總額，去年已超過國內生產毛額(GDP)的300%，較2019年底增加60個百分點，占比也遠高於美國。自習近平2012年底掌權以來，這項信用總額已增加逾43兆美元。

債務推升過剩產能 壓力透過出口向海外擴散

報導指出，大量借款流向需求不足的工廠與住宅建設，造成資源浪費，並引發激烈價格戰，侵蝕企業獲利與員工薪資。背負龐大債務的企業為了償債，持續生產超出國內需求的汽車、太陽能板與電子產品，再將商品銷往海外，使中國對全球的年度貿易順差達到約1兆美元。
這也讓中國債務問題逐漸外溢。包括歐洲在內的貿易夥伴，對中國電動車及其他產品大量湧入日益不滿，但北京目前似乎無意根本改變政策方向。
許多經濟學家認為，中國尚未面臨迫在眉睫的金融危機，部分原因是債務主要仰賴國內儲蓄支應，而非可能迅速撤資的外國投資人。不過，隨著經濟成長動能停滯，虧損企業背負的大量債務愈來愈難償還；若停止向這些企業提供新貸款，又可能使國有銀行承受鉅額損失。
榮鼎集團副董事Camille Boullenois表示，改變現有體系意味必須接受大量損失，而中國政府似乎尚未做好準備。她認為，較可能出現的情境是問題緩慢惡化，金融體系逐步衰退，創造成長的效率愈來愈低。
延後處理債務，也讓習近平得以繼續將資源投入新科技、軍事及其他戰略優先項目。中國官員認為，目前是確立中國與美國並列大國地位的機會窗口，因此將AI、太空科技與能源等核心技術投資視為關鍵。

地方融資平台負擔沉重 低利貸款延續企業借款

中國政府強調債務風險可控，近年中央政府借款約占GDP的30%，相較美國聯邦政府債務水準仍低。然而，這項數字並未涵蓋中國債務問題的主要來源，也就是地方層級的負擔。
過去幾年，地方政府為達成經濟成長目標、維持就業，透過地方政府融資平台新增數兆美元負債。許多平台參與地方房地產開發，也因此受到多年房市低迷重創。
國際貨幣基金(IMF)估計，若將地方政府官方借款及融資平台債務一併納入，中國廣義政府債務去年已膨脹至GDP的127%，高於2020年的98%。
企業債務也在具備良好報酬前景的投資機會減少之際持續增加。麥肯錫資料顯示，中國去年企業債務占GDP比率，約為全球平均的兩倍。
低成本信貸是重要推手。榮鼎集團引述中國央行資料指出，截至去年底，超過半數新增企業貸款的利率，等於或低於銀行提供給最優質企業客戶的貸款基準利率，比重遠高於幾年前。中國上市製造業公司去年的借款利率中位數約為2.4%。

擴大消費有助打破循環 政策轉向面臨戰略取捨

要化解債務問題，中國可能必須根本調整成長策略，降低對工廠等固定資產投資及商品出口的依賴。許多經濟學家主張，政府應優先採取能鼓勵家庭增加支出的政策，避免債務持續累積。
世界銀行資料顯示，2024年中國家庭消費占GDP的40%，美國則接近70%，反映兩國經濟結構的明顯差異。
中國今年第二季GDP年增4.3%，為逾三年來最慢增速，其中相當部分成長來自出口，也凸顯國內需求不足的問題。
北京雖表示希望提高家庭消費，但這意味政府必須減少對經濟資源配置的部分控制，也可能使資金從習近平優先扶植、用以縮小對美科技差距的產業流出。
柏林智庫墨卡托中國研究中心經濟與產業研究主管Jacob Gunter表示，中國官員傾向延續現有路線，但體系已逐漸觸及自身極限。他指出，地方政府補貼虧損企業以維持其營運，然而企業持續虧損，也代表沒有利潤可供課稅，進一步削弱地方財政收入基礎。
paras_en: China continues to push its technology and military superpower goals through massive investment, but its debt burden is rising in tandem, squeezing domestic economic vitality and, via excess capacity and export expansion, deepening friction with trade partners. Economists note that a financial crisis may not erupt in the short term, but if China keeps relying on cheap credit to support investment and loss‑making firms, the financial system could gradually lose efficiency, paying more debt without corresponding growth.

According to a Wall Street Journal report on Monday (the 12th), data from the Bank for International Settlements (BIS) show that total credit for China’s non‑financial sector—including corporate, government and household borrowing—exceeded 300% of GDP last year, up 60 percentage points since the end of 2019 and far higher than the United States. Since Xi Jinping took power at the end of 2012, this total credit has grown by more than $43 trillion.

Debt‑driven excess capacity spreads pressure abroad through exports. The report says large volumes of borrowing have flowed into factories and housing projects that lack demand, wasting resources and sparking fierce price wars that erode corporate profits and workers’ wages. Heavily indebted firms, to service their debt, keep producing cars, solar panels and electronics beyond domestic demand and ship them overseas, helping China generate an annual global trade surplus of about $1 trillion.

This also causes China’s debt problem to spill over. Trade partners, including Europe, are increasingly dissatisfied with the flood of Chinese electric vehicles and other products, yet Beijing appears unwilling to fundamentally change policy direction.

Many economists believe China is not yet facing an imminent financial crisis, partly because its debt is mainly funded by domestic savings rather than foreign investors who could pull out quickly. However, as growth momentum stalls, the massive debt carried by loss‑making firms becomes ever harder to repay; cutting off new loans to these firms could force state‑owned banks to absorb huge losses.

Camille Boullenois, vice‑chair of Rongding Group, said that changing the current system would require accepting large losses, and the Chinese government does not seem ready. She thinks the more likely scenario is a slow worsening of problems, a gradual decline of the financial system and increasingly low efficiency in generating growth.

Delaying debt resolution also lets Xi Jinping keep pouring resources into new technologies, the military and other strategic priorities. Chinese officials see the current window as an opportunity to cement China’s status as a peer great power with the United States, so they treat investments in AI, space technology and energy as critical.

Local financing platforms carry heavy burdens, and low‑interest loans keep corporate borrowing alive. The Chinese government stresses that debt risks are controllable; central‑government borrowing has been about 30% of GDP in recent years, still lower than the United States’ federal debt level. However, this figure does not include the main source of China’s debt problem—the liabilities at the local level.

In recent years, local governments have added several trillion dollars of debt through local financing platforms to meet growth targets and preserve employment. Many of these platforms have been involved in local real‑estate development and have therefore been hit hard by years of a sluggish housing market.

The International Monetary Fund estimates that if official local‑government borrowing and financing‑platform debt are combined, China’s broad‑based government debt swelled to 127% of GDP last year, up from 98% in 2020.

Corporate debt is also rising even as investment opportunities with good returns are dwindling. McKinsey data show that China’s corporate‑debt‑to‑GDP ratio last year was about twice the global average.

Cheap credit is a key driver. Rongding Group cites People’s Bank of China data indicating that by the end of last year, more than half of new corporate loans were priced at or below the benchmark rate offered to the most creditworthy corporate clients, a share far higher than a few years ago. The median borrowing rate for listed Chinese manufacturers was about 2.4% last year.

Expanding consumption could help break the cycle, but policy shifts involve strategic trade‑offs. To resolve the debt issue, China may need to fundamentally adjust its growth strategy, reducing reliance on factory‑type fixed‑asset investment and export‑driven growth. Many economists argue the government should prioritize policies that encourage households to spend more, preventing further debt accumulation.

World Bank data show that in 2024 household consumption accounted for 40% of China’s GDP, compared with nearly 70% in the United States, highlighting a stark structural difference between the two economies.

China’s GDP grew 4.3% year‑on‑year in the second quarter of this year, the slowest pace in over three years, with a sizable share of that growth coming from exports, underscoring weak domestic demand.

Beijing says it wants to boost household consumption, but that would require the government to relinquish some control over economic resource allocation and could divert funds away from industries that Xi prioritizes to narrow the technology gap with the United States.

Jacob Gunter, head of economics and industry research at the Berlin‑based Mercator Institute for China Studies, said Chinese officials tend to stick to the current path, but the system is gradually hitting its own limits. He noted that local governments subsidize loss‑making firms to keep them operating, yet continued losses mean there is no profit to tax, further eroding the fiscal base of local governments.

items.title: 〈台幣〉股匯震盪一度重貶逾1角 貶幅收斂險守31.9元關卡
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar, Stocks and Forex Volatile, Briefly Dropped Over 0.1, Decline Narrowed, Barely Held the 31.9 Level
paras: 雙十連假過後，台北股匯今(12)日連袂走跌，受中東局勢緊張、國際油價漲勢再起影響，新台幣兌美元一度重挫逾 1 角，但在央行進場調節後，貶勢逐漸收斂，終場收在 31.895 元、小貶 2 分，驚險守住 31.9 元關卡，台北與元太外匯市場總成交值 27.17 億美元。
觀察主要貨幣今天對美元表現，根據央行統計，美元指數小跌 0.03%，韓元強勢升值 0.79%，新加坡幣與人民幣均升值 0.12%；日元則貶值 0.18%，新台幣貶值 0.06%，主要亞幣走勢不同調。
台股今日面臨電子權值壓盤，但台積電跌幅收斂，金融股、貨櫃海運三雄齊力拉抬，加權指數開低走高，留下逾 500 點下影線，49000 點失而復得，終場小跌 11.48 點，收49301.96點。外資今日賣超 521.98 億元。
儘管近期經濟數據顯示美國通膨壓力持續存在，但市場對聯準會本月稍晚政策會議升息的預期仍相對有限。根據CME FedWatch工具，市場目前預估，聯準會本月升息至少1碼的機率為19.4%，不過，認為12月會議升息的機率高達85.8%。
paras_en: After the Double‑Ten holiday, Taipei’s stock and forex markets fell together on the 12th. Fueled by heightened Middle‑East tensions and a resurgence in global oil prices, the New Taiwan dollar slipped more than 0.1 against the US dollar. After the central bank stepped in to smooth the market, the depreciation eased and closed at 31.895 NT$, a modest 2‑cent loss, narrowly staying above the 31.9 threshold. The total turnover in Taipei and Yuan‑Tai foreign‑exchange markets amounted to US$2.717 billion.

Looking at major currencies against the dollar today, central‑bank data show the US Dollar Index fell 0.03%. The Korean won appreciated strongly by 0.79%, while the Singapore dollar and the Chinese yuan each rose 0.12%. The Japanese yen weakened 0.18% and the New Taiwan dollar fell 0.06%, indicating divergent moves among Asian currencies.

Taiwan’s equity market faced pressure from heavyweight electronics stocks, but TSMC’s losses narrowed. Financial stocks and the three major container‑shipping firms rallied, pushing the weighted index from an opening decline to a gain, leaving a lower shadow of over 500 points. The 49,000‑point level was briefly lost and then regained, ending down 11.48 points at 49,301.96. Foreign investors sold a net US$52.198 billion today.

Although recent economic data show that inflation pressure in the United States remains, market expectations for a rate hike at this month’s Federal Reserve meeting are still relatively modest. According to the CME FedWatch tool, the probability of at least a one‑basis‑point increase this month is 19.4%, while the chance of a hike at the December meeting is as high as 85.8%.

items.title: 油價回落與出口商拋售 韓元飆升至兩年新高
items.title_en: Oil price drop and exporters sell-off, Won soars to two-year high
paras: 韓元周一(12日)飆升至兩年來新高，主要受國際油價下跌和南韓國內企業大量拋售美元的支撐。
在結束為期3天的公眾假期後，南韓外匯市場周一恢復交易，韓元兌美元強勁升值。韓元匯率盤中一度下跌 0.8% 至1美元兌 1,333.30 韓元，刷新近兩年來最高，隨後漲幅收窄至約 0.5%。
市場分析師，本次韓元走強主要受雙重因素驅動。首先，國際原油價格下挫削弱了美元強勢，帶動歐元、英鎊與日元等主要貨幣全面回升。其次，南韓本土出口企業(特別是半導體巨頭)大量拋售美元，加上創紀錄的出口成長與經常帳順差擴大，大幅增加了外匯市場上的美元供給。
首爾友利銀行(Woori Bank)經濟學家 Min Gyeong-won 指出，出口商的結匯需求將持續為韓元提供支撐，不過當天因日本市場休市導致整體交易量較為清淡，進一步加劇了匯率波動。
今年以來，韓元兌美元已累計升值達 7.7%。憑藉強勁的出口表現與企業結匯潮，韓元已擺脫上半年作為亞洲表現最差貨幣之一的陰霾，逆轉成為下半年亞洲地區表現最強勁的貨幣之一。
paras_en: The Korean won surged to a two‑year high on Monday the 12th, driven mainly by falling international oil prices and a massive sell‑off of dollars by South Korean companies.

After a three‑day public holiday, South Korea’s foreign‑exchange market resumed trading on Monday and the won appreciated sharply against the dollar. The rate briefly fell 0.8% to 1,333.30 won per dollar, a near‑two‑year peak, before the gain narrowed to about 0.5%.

Market analysts say the won’s strength this time was driven by two factors. First, the drop in global crude oil prices weakened the dollar, prompting a broad rally in major currencies such as the euro, pound and yen. Second, domestic exporters – especially semiconductor giants – dumped large amounts of dollars, and record export growth together with an expanding current‑account surplus greatly increased the supply of dollars in the FX market.

Woori Bank economist Min Gyeong‑won noted that exporters’ demand for foreign‑exchange settlement will continue to support the won, but trading was relatively thin that day because the Japanese market was closed, which further amplified rate volatility.

Since the start of the year, the won has appreciated by 7.7% against the dollar. Backed by strong export performance and a wave of corporate settlement, the won has shed its reputation as one of Asia’s worst‑performing currencies in the first half and has turned into one of the strongest performers in the region for the second half.

paras: 美元周五(9日)上漲，歐元則連續第五周下跌。隨著油價回升、抹去稍早跌幅，歐元早盤漲勢逐漸消退。不過，由於法國陷入困境的公債市場趨於穩定，歐元近期的賣壓有所緩和。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.13%，報102.25。美元指數本周上漲約0.3%，連續第四周走高，寫下2025年5月以來最長連漲紀錄。
本周一，歐元兌美元一度跌至1.1161美元，創17個月新低。投資人憂心法國公共債務創下歷史新高，且政府削減預算支出的政治之路困難重重。相較之下，美國經濟與美元則顯得相對強勁。
歐元兌美元下跌0.1%，至1.1198美元，本周累計下跌約0.5%，創下2025年初以來兌美元連續周線下跌最長紀錄。
法國與義大利公債的風險溢價本周有望下滑。這些溢價在9月下旬曾大幅攀升，但隨著投資人等待新的局勢發展，再決定是否要求更高的報酬，以補償財政與政治風險，近期風險溢價已逐步回落。
川普暗示不會攻擊伊朗
周五稍早，全球債券市場趨於平靜。美國總統川普表示，美國不會在11月3日美國期中選舉前攻擊伊朗，並稱美國與德黑蘭當局就戰事進行了富有成果的談判。受此消息影響，油價稍早下跌。

paras_en: The dollar rose on Friday (the 9th), while the euro fell for a fifth straight week. As oil prices recovered, erasing earlier losses, the euro’s early‑session gains gradually faded. However, with France’s troubled sovereign‑bond market stabilising, selling pressure on the euro has eased somewhat recently.

In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.13% to 102.25. The index is up about 0.3% this week, marking a fourth consecutive week of gains and the longest winning streak since May 2025.

On Monday, the euro slipped to $1.1161, a 17‑month low. Investors worry that France’s public debt has hit a historic high and that the political path to cutting budget spending is fraught with difficulty. By contrast, the U.S. economy and the dollar appear relatively strong.
The euro fell 0.1% to $1.1198, down about 0.5% for the week, setting the longest run of weekly declines against the dollar since early 2025.

Risk premiums on French and Italian sovereign bonds are expected to fall this week. Those premiums surged in late September, but as investors await new developments and decide whether higher compensation is needed for fiscal and political risk, the premiums have been gradually retreating.
Trump hints he will not attack Iran

Earlier on Friday, global bond markets steadied. U.S. President Donald Trump said the United States will not attack Iran before the November 3 mid‑term elections and claimed that the U.S. and Tehran had productive war‑related talks. The news knocked oil prices lower earlier in the session.

Eugene Epstein, head of transactions and structured products at Moneycorp, said, “There are several factors at play right now, including rising oil prices and France’s issues, so it’s hard to pinpoint which factor is having the bigger market impact.”

“In reality, I think the market is in a wait‑and‑see mode today. Everyone is waiting for Fed officials’ remarks to roll out, because it’s clear the dollar is very sensitive to whatever the Fed speakers say,” he added.

However, the UK Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) reported that a vessel 13 nautical miles west of the UAE peninsula was struck by an unidentified flying object, after which crude oil prices rebounded from their lows.
U.S. crude rose 0.6% to $92.04 a barrel, after dipping to a intraday low of $90.01. Brent crude gained 0.58% to $104.88, after an earlier low of $102.33.
Bond yields around the world have been climbing for several weeks, driven by expectations of rate hikes by central banks and concerns over sovereign fiscal health.
Central‑bank policy is in focus
Even though recent economic data show persistent inflation pressure, market expectations for a rate hike at this month’s Fed policy meeting remain relatively modest.

According to the CME FedWatch tool, the market currently assigns a 19.4% probability that the Fed will raise rates by at least one basis point this month, while the odds of a hike at the December meeting are as high as 85.8%.

A Michigan University consumer survey released on Friday showed that, as Middle‑East conflict pushes up living costs, U.S. consumer confidence slipped further in early October and households grew more pessimistic about the economic outlook.

While several Fed officials have said further rate hikes may be needed to curb inflation, some have opposed an immediate increase, arguing the Fed should stay patient and flexible before deciding the future rate path.

French sovereign bonds remain under pressure, and politicians find it hard to meaningfully cut the budget deficit before a divisive 2027 election. Earlier this week, Spain announced an early election, adding further pressure on the euro.
The pound rose 0.08% to $1.3235 against the dollar but has been falling for a seventh consecutive week, the longest streak of declines since November 2024.
The dollar gained 0.25% against the yen to ¥158.25. The yen may be on track for a fourth straight week of weakness, down about 0.2% for the week.
